import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params; L=np.log(eps)
    return (p[0]*T**1.5 + p[1]*T**0.5/eps + p[2]*T/eps + p[3]*T**2*L + p[4]*T**4*L + p[5]*T**4/eps
            + p[6]*T**3*L**2 + p[7]*T**4*L**2 + p[8]*T**2.5/eps + p[9]*L/eps)
